# xpm

**Tag**: desktop

## 简介

Universal package manager for any unix-like distro including macOS. Also experimental Windows support.

## 官网

- 主页: https://xpm.link
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/verseles/xpm
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/xpm
